research_insight_text_link.research_insight_description: Sesame is developing a system that integrates eye tracking technology into eyewear devices, allowing users to perform search queries based on their gaze. This system captures the user's gaze location near an object and processes images of the local area to facilitate the search. This innovation highlights Sesame's focus on enhancing user interaction with intelligent voice companions and eyewear devices through advanced gaze-assisted technology.

overview_description.description: Sesame is a voice tech startup focused on developing AI voice assistants that create natural and emotionally resonant conversations. It focuses on technologies such as natural language processing, machine learning, and computer vision to create applications like personal assistants, healthcare solutions, and customer service chatbots. The company engages in research and development, collaborating with institutions to advance AI responsibly while addressing ethical considerations. Its goal is to improve accessibility and productivity through intelligent systems that adapt to human needs.

product.name: Sesame Personal Agents
product.description: Voice-based personal AI agents available in an iOS and Android preview. They support natural conversations for exploring ideas, following topics, and discovering information.

product.name: Sesame Intelligent Eyewear
product.description: Voice-enabled eyewear designed to provide hands-free access to Sesame personal agents, with all-day comfort and high-quality audio. The product is planned for release in 2027.

product.name: Conversational Speech Model (CSM)
product.description: A multimodal speech model that uses conversation history and interleaved text and audio to generate more contextually appropriate, expressive speech with low-latency inference.
